superpowers.notes: Method layer for clarification, TDD, debugging, and execution discipline. v6 is published via the obra/superpowers marketplace; claude-plugins-official marketplace only carries the v5 line.

caveman.notes: Communication compression layer. v1.9.1 install.sh is a Node wrapper around bin/install.js (requires Node ≥18). v1.9.1 changed the install layout — files now land in ~/.config/opencode/{plugins,commands,skills,agents}/ and rules are appended to AGENTS.md; the legacy ~/.agents/skills/caveman/SKILL.md path is no longer created. Trailing empty args are not safe to forward — install.js treats them as unknown flags. Pin tracks the v1.9.1 release tag; bump on upstream changelog warrant.

rtk.notes: Compresses Bash/tool output only; built-in Read/Grep/Glob do not pass through RTK hooks.

openspec.notes: Installs the CLI only; project-local 'openspec init' stays explicit.

ecc.notes: Use for framework, security, research, and integration depth; local scope is not supported. ECC v2+ ships as the npm-published `ecc-universal@latest` package which exposes an `ecc-install` bin (symlink to scripts/install-apply.js) for OpenCode/Claude targets. The publish path includes pre-built artifacts so no separate `npm run build:opencode` is required for the npm route; the git clone fallback still needs that build step. latest-installer strategy tracks upstream HEAD at repair time; first-install determinism is no longer guaranteed.

claude-mem.notes: Cross-session memory layer complementary to caveman.
